cluster_reason: FastDateFormat, FastDateParser and FastDatePrinter form a cohesive formatting/parsing cluster: FastDateFormat delegates to both the printer and the parser and the three classes have strong internal interactions. Moving them together isolates date formatting/parsing implementation details into a dedicated subpackage with minimal package-private exposure to the remaining time utilities.

blocks.goal: Move the FastDateFormat cluster (formatting and parsing classes) into a dedicated subpackage.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move FastDateFormat to the new format subpackage alongside its printer and parser.
Move FastDateParser to the new format subpackage to keep parser implementation colocated with the formatter.
Move FastDatePrinter to the new format subpackage to keep printing logic with the formatter and parser.
